messages.subject: QTL chart

Hi, someone has code or experience plotting QTL charts in ggplot2? I saw a lot of information for Manhattan plots but not for QTL. Especially, because I am want to plot multiple traits or locations in the same chart

Thanks

Eduardo

messages.author: 942ffec526d6a312
messages.subject: Re: QTL chart
parts:
Hi Eduardo,

I'm guessing you are talking about a plot of LOD scores or p-values against position?
If so, it is just a point or line graph, or both (geom_point, geom_line).

When you say you want multiple traits on one chart do you mean different facets wtihn
the chart or different coloured lines on the same chart?

Multiple chromosomes? Or one? If multiple, facet_* by chromosome, or a single plot
the chromosomes ordered 1-N?

Your question does not provide much information, but it sounds relatively straightforward.
Could you give us some dummy data and whatever you've tried so far (or at least a description
of what the chart should look like).

Ron.
